mentions.name: Superlog
mentions.description: Superlog is a Sentry replacement that automatically adds logs to a project and fixes any bugs it finds. Setup is done via a single prompt that installs Superlog into the project, and all platform functionality is usable through MCP so users don't have to spend time configuring yet another UI.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building a Sentry replacement that adds logs automatically and fixes any bugs it finds (https://superlog.sh).

The setup is done via one prompt ('Use https://skills.superlog.sh to install Superlog in this project'), and everything on the platform is usable via MCP so that you don't have to spend time configuring yet another UI.
